items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Now, when I met him in Sebastian's Cotton Club, he was working with Les Hite.

ctx.x: Now, Les Hite used to play with Louie whenever he came to Sebastian's Cotton Club. He used to use his band. Les Hite also recorded with Louie. He made 'Song of the Islands'. That's where the first vibraphones was played on Lionel Hampton. They got him a vibraphone to play and that was Lionel playing the chords on 'Song of the Islands' that Louie made back there.
